## Remote helper C library

The `lamina-remote` binaries shipped in `remote-helpers/` are static musl
executables. They are not linked against the host C library. The C library
they do contain comes from Zig 0.17.1, the same toolchain the terminal backend
uses. That toolchain vendors musl and replaces some of its functions with its
own code. Neither is a Cargo crate, so `cargo-about` does not list them. The
crate graph of `lamina-remote` is otherwise the same graph the notices above
already walk.
